responsibility: Implements GCC’s minimal standard <stdcountof.h> header for ISO C2Y array-count support by exporting the public `countof` macro as an alias of the core language/operator spelling `_Countof`. Its responsibility is purely to expose the standardized source-level name for compile-time array element counting in user code and front-end parsing, without defining any counting logic, runtime behavior, or target-specific semantics itself.
